# `kernel/arch/sparc/rcons` — architecture-specific machine-dependent code for the 4.5BSD kernel — sparc/rcons

## English

This directory contains architecture-specific machine-dependent code for the 4.5BSD kernel — sparc/rcons.

`config.mk` records 5 source file(s) here: `raster_op.c`, `raster_text.c`, `rcons_font.c`, `rcons_kern.c`, `rcons_subr.c`.

These `config.mk` lists are reference metadata from the 4.5BSD tree; the BSD45 build scripts (`build_kernel.ps1` / `build_kernel.sh`) select the files that are actually compiled.
